description: 積込 loading-robot cycle record (palletize finished PV modules + load onto an internal hikari-install carrier), emitted by the himawari panel_loading cell. COMPOSES — never clones — the LANDED sarutahiko F10 LoaderRobot (ADR-2606013100, 14 tests green); the physical pick→carry→lower cycle (LoadPhase::{ToPick,Carry,Lower,Done}) is authoritative in the kami-engine crate kami-app-sarutahiko-factory, and this record only anchors that cycle outcome on-chain. Sixth link in the polysilicon → wafer → cell → module → loading → outbound provenance chain (G11 traceability); each module serial chains back to com.etzhayyim.himawari.moduleAttestation. G7 (labor-liberation transparency — every human task automated-away logged to the Liberation Metric, ADR-2605261000) + G12 (no external commercial PV sale — internal hikari install only, SBT↔SBT carve-out, ADR-2605192115 §3) structural enforcement. Materializes into the kotoba Datom log (EAVT, canonical state — G6); each property is one attribute under the :loading/* namespace keyed by the record CID, and per-cycle history is queryable as-of any point. solar-grade c-Si only (N1) — NOT the iwakura/fuigo/tsukuru logic-grade EG-Si track. Per ADR-2606021200.

loadingId.description: himawari-assigned stable loading-cycle identifier; sixth link in the polysilicon → wafer → cell → module → loading → outbound serial chain (G11 traceability). Datom :loading/id.

recordedAt.description: cycle attestation timestamp (ISO-8601); as-of point for the kotoba Datom history of this loading cycle

moduleSerials.description: G11/G12: finished-module serials handed off this cycle; each chains back to com.etzhayyim.himawari.moduleAttestation.moduleSerial (and through it to the feedstock lot). Materialized as repeated :loading/module-serial datoms.

palletCount.description: number of pallets in this cycle = ceil(len(moduleSerials) / palletCapacity); the F10 straddle loader moves one pallet per pick→carry→lower cycle. Datom :loading/pallet-count.

carrierDid.description: DID of the receiving carrier. G12: must be an internal hikari-install carrier (SBT↔SBT carve-out); a non-internal carrier is refused at the cell and no record is emitted. Datom :loading/carrier-did.

carrierInternal.description: G12 gate flag — true iff the carrier is an internal hikari-install carrier. The panel_loading cell refuses (emits no record) when false; this attribute records the satisfied gate for audit.

loaderRobotDid.description: G7: composed sarutahiko F10 LoaderRobot lineage DID (default did:web:etzhayyim.com:sarutahiko#F10-loader). Names the robot whose automation displaced manual loading, so the cycle is accountable to the Liberation Metric. Datom :loading/loader-robot-did.

loaderPhase.description: terminal LoadPhase reported by the composed F10 LoaderRobot (mirror of the authoritative Rust LoadPhase enum); 'Done' = cycle complete. himawari recognizes the phase, it does not re-run the kinematics.

humanTasksRemovedCid.description: G7: content-addressed manifest of the manual tasks this fully-automated cycle displaced, logged to the Liberation Metric (ADR-2605261000). An empty manifest yields a zero-task CID rather than omitting the field — automation here is the point, but it must be accounted, never opaque. Datom :loading/human-tasks-removed-cid.

cycleStateLogCid.description: content-addressed F10 loader phase-transition log for this cycle (which LoadPhases the composed loader traversed). Audit anchor for the composed sarutahiko cycle telemetry. Datom :loading/cycle-state-log-cid.

attestingRobots.description: G7-coupled Ed25519 robot witness attestations over the completed loading cycle (loader + any metrology/AGV witnesses). >=1 (the F10 loader itself); pallet-count and serial-set integrity may add further witnesses.

robotSignature.description: G7-coupled Ed25519 robot witness attestation. Robot DID lineage logged so automated-away human loading tasks are accountable to the Liberation Metric (ADR-2605261000).

role.description: witness role (e.g. straddle-loader / palletizer / AGV-handoff / serial-scan / mass-check)

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the attested loading-cycle bundle
